overview: A styled code display component for presenting code samples, terminal output, and technical snippets in a monospaced block format. Supports syntax highlighting via a language label, an optional copy button, and comment-line styling. For a short inline code reference within prose, use the Code element instead.

whenToUse: Displaying code snippets, shell commands, or configuration examples that users may need to copy
Inline developer documentation where syntax context (via the language label) aids comprehension
do: Pass a raw JavaScript template string as `children` to preserve whitespace and line breaks
Set the `language` prop to accurately label the code type (e.g. `"python"`, `"typescript"`)
dont: Pass React nodes or rich content as children, only strings
